title: VST ($$$): Jan $87.50 puts sold
summary: 5,500 January 2027 $87.50 puts sold to open at $0.79 on 11/24, following 8,700 Dec 24 weekly $95 short puts on 11/23 and 14,600 March $85 short puts on 11/5; a 600 February $135 call buy at $8.62 on 11/23; spot $121.30. Shares -24.8% YTD, lost 50/200-day in late October but held above the 11/5 low; 50-day near $140 resistance, support at the November low near $111. Desk lean: sell puts under the November low as the entry. $$$ Featured.

title: MRNA ($$): Feb $230 calls bought

title: Desk market wrap 11/25
summary: Stocks opened sharply lower on fresh tariff threats and a tech-rally stall (VIX ~31), SPY sold off hard early then recovered nearly all of it; solar was the standout group and breadth flipped positive midday as the VIX fell. Trend still lower with SPY below the 8- and 21-day. S&P resistance 7,330 / support 6,970. Semis leaders AMD, SMTC, MU, ALAB, AMAT saw large long-dated puts sold to open into the selloff. Markets closed Thursday for Thanksgiving; Friday half-session.
